data.title: Jaguar Animal Health Announces Reverse Stock Split Plans
data.description:
Jaguar Animal Health ( (JAGX) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Jaguar Health, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that develops novel proprietary prescription drugs sustainably derived from plants for patients with complicated gastrointestinal disease states. Through its subsidiaries Napo Pharmaceuticals and Napo Therapeutics, Jaguar focuses on crofelemer-based treatments for rare and orphan GI disorders, while joint venture Magdalena Biosciences targets plant-derived prescription medicines for mental health indications.

The company’s portfolio is centered on addressing severe intestinal failure conditions such as microvillus inclusion disease and short bowel syndrome. This specialized focus positions Jaguar and its affiliated entities within niche therapeutic markets, where unmet medical needs and orphan-drug dynamics can offer differentiated growth opportunities and potential strategic value for stakeholders.

Jaguar Health announced on September 15, 2026 that it will implement a one-for-fifteen reverse stock split of its common stock, effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 17, 2026, following shareholder approval at a special meeting held on April 20, 2026. The move is intended to support the company’s compliance with Nasdaq listing standards, with shares continuing to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the JAGX ticker on a split-adjusted basis.

At the effective time, every fifteen issued and outstanding shares will be reclassified into one share, with no change to par value and no alteration to the total number of authorized common or preferred shares. Outstanding stock options, warrants, and equity plan reserves will be proportionately reduced, exercise and conversion prices adjusted upward, and fractional shareholders compensated in cash, while Equiniti Trust Company will manage the share exchange process.

data.title: 5E Advanced Materials to Acquire Searles Valley Assets
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. ( (FEAM) ).

On September 14, 2026, 5E Advanced Materials and its subsidiary 5E SVM entered an agreement to acquire Searles Valley Minerals’ key operating assets through a court-supervised Section 363 bankruptcy sale in Delaware. The deal covers production facilities at Argus, Westend and Trona, more than 9,000 acres of Searles Lake brine resources, the Trona Railway short-line railroad, water infrastructure and related utilities, permits and contracts in San Bernardino County, California.

The consideration totals about $3.4 million in cash, 8.3 million shares of 5E common stock and an approximately $6.2 million senior unsecured promissory note, with 5E SVM also assuming specified environmental compliance obligations and other liabilities tied to the assets. Closing, expected in early October 2026, is subject to Bankruptcy Court approval, Surface Transportation Board authorization for the rail assets and the company’s receipt of $10 million in senior secured bridge financing, which will be guaranteed by 5E and secured against 5E SVM’s assets.
